newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks end mixed, restrained by weak golds.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks end mixed, restrained by weak golds.

text.p: * Toronto's key 300 index closed higher on Thursday, but the broader market ended mixed, restrained by battered gold stocks * Declining issues edged past advances 487 to 482.
Toronto's key stock index closed higher on Thursday, but the broader market ended mixed as gains were restrained by weakness in the heavyweight gold sector.
The TSE 300 Composite Index rose 13.82 points to close at 6085.10. However, declining issues edged out advances 487 to 482 with 297 stocks flat.
The key gold group lost nearly 1.6 percent as bullion prices continued to tumble. "That's the group that really took it away from us, offsetting any gains," said Montreal-based strategist Bill Ram.
